title: Who are you !
author: Manjula Asthana Mahanti
text:
A strong urge knocks
Quite often, naturally
Should be quenched philsophically
As our journey is all about
Beauty and depth,
Within that, wears a sheen, forever
Every challange is designed
To chisel away at all
That`s brittle in order to sculpt
A fabulous masterpiece
In the intrinsic you....!
Incredible wisdom blossoms
As one discovers own unique mission,
Begin uncovering, true ability
Introspect completely
It`s not about, what you wish,
It`s merely about, who you are i
Mark your persona
Let`s put more efforts to mine
The beautiful, glittering jewels within...!
Fair statement...
Determination without directions, is illusive.....
